intro.body:
The training activities of the program – which are mandatory for all doctoral candidates – are those listed below.

(*) Obtaining a favorable report on the program’s training activities is a prerequisite for defending the doctoral thesis. To achieve this, it is necessary to have participated and received a ‘satisfactory’ grade in at least 80% of them (i.e., in eight of them), provided that the training activities undertaken allow for the attainment of all the competencies indicated in the title’s verification report associated with the Training Activities (these competencies can be consulted here.
